description:
## Description

Plot (a) examines the impact of encoder size, with T5-Small, T5-Large, T5-XL, and T5-XXL models. The T5-XXL model has the highest FID-10K score, while T5-Small has the lowest. Plot (b) shows the impact of U-Net size, with 300M, 500M, 1B, and 2B models. The 2B model has the highest FID-10K score, and the 300M model has the lowest. caption: Figure A.4: Visualization of Imagen. Imagen uses a frozen text encoder to encode the input text into text embeddings. A conditional diffusion model maps the text embedding into a 64 × 64 image. Imagen further utilizes text-conditional super-resolution diffusion models to upsample the image, first 64 × 64 → 256 × 256 , and then 256 × 256 → 1024 × 1024 .
description:
Description: This figure is a flowchart illustrating the process of generating images from text using the Imagen model. It starts with a text input that is encoded into text embeddings by a frozen text encoder. These embeddings are then used by a text-to-image diffusion model to create a 64x64 image. The process continues with two super-resolution diffusion models that upsample the image to 256x256 and then to 1024x1024.

Text in figure: Text, Frozen Text Encoder, Text Embedding, Text-to-Image Diffusion Model, 64x64 Image, Super-Resolution Diffusion Model, 256x256 Image, Super-Resolution Diffusion Model, 1024x1024 Image, "A Golden Retriever dog wearing a blue checkered beret and red dotted turtleneck."
